subject: Repeated trial top-ups flagged — decision & next steps (CloudNova)

Subject: Request: additional trial credits — urgent for POC week

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved the throughput. We're in the middle of a one-week POC and hit our anticipated token usage faster than expected. Can Redwood issue another short trial top-up (just enough for 3 more days) so we can finish end-to-end testing with our security folks?

We've previously used the initial 50k trial and then requested an extension last quarter while onboarding two additional testers (both internal). We haven't launched to customers — only internal eval. Happy to sign an MSA or provide billing details if that helps.

Appreciate the quick help.

Best,
Alex Lee
Director of Engineering
CloudNova

Thanks for the note and glad the demo went well. I can escalate a one-off top-up, but before I do I need to confirm a couple of quick items to make sure this isn't abuse of the trial flow: 1) are the additional testers all on company domains or are you inviting external contractors? 2) do you have multiple accounts or test orgs in our system? 3) any previous promo codes applied in past 90 days?

I'm looping in Rishi from Risk to speed the approval — he may ask for usage logs. If you can reply with a one-line answer to the three items above, we'll triage and respond within the day.

—Priyom

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits — follow-up (CloudNova)

Priyom / Marissa / Evelyn —

I pulled the preliminary account history for CloudNova (org id: CN-985). Notes:
- 2026-08-12: Initial trial issued (50k tokens).
- 2026-09-03: Manual extension issued (20k) after sales ask — documented in HS: deal DN-2026-672.
- 2026-11-03: Separate account/email aliased by same billing name requested another 15k (approved).
- 2026-11-18: Current request.

Evidence of potential abuse: three distinct account identifiers tied to the same billing email/domain and a pattern of repeated small top-ups timed before POC/demo weeks. I need the following from CloudNova to consider another manual credit:
  1) The list of tester emails (internal vs external).
  2) Proof these are employees (payroll/okta/ID) OR a commitment to move to a paid seat/contract if usage continues.
  3) Clarify whether any promo codes were used across the accounts.

If CloudNova can provide the items above, we can consider a controlled 10k credit but mark the org as "monitor-only" with token thresholds and auto-suspension for new account creation. If not, we should decline and propose a paid pilot with a short-term invoice.

I'll also request logs from infra for overlapping API keys / IPs.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Risk & Trust Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Lee <alex.lee@cloudnova.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Support Team <support@cloudnova.ai>

Hi Priyom / Rishi —

Thanks for the quick review. Short answers below:
1) Testers: five emails, 3 @cloudnova.ai employees (internal), 2 vendor contractors (vendor-managed emails).
2) Proof: we can provide a list and Okta screenshots for the 3 employees; contractors are on fixed-term SOWs and cannot be given full access to Okta, but we can provide SOW PDFs and contractor agreements.
3) Promo codes: no external promo codes applied; we did accept a one-off extension in Sept (as Rishi noted) when onboarding two new engineers.

We're open to converting to a paid pilot immediately; if Redwood can provide a short-term invoice for the pilot (10k credits) we can process it this week. If not, we politely request a one-time 10k grant to complete the POC.

Attached: usage-summary.csv (attachment stub), SOW-Contractor-Jones.pdf (attachment stub)

Regards,
Alex
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Lee <alex.lee@cloudnova.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: additional trial credits — decision & next steps (CloudNova)

Alex —

Appreciate the quick answers and the attachments. After reviewing the usage logs and the contract docs with Risk and Commercial, here's Redwood's decision:

- We will NOT issue another complimentary trial top-up.
- Offer: We can convert the POC into a short-term paid pilot: 10k token bundle invoiced net-30 (PO required) with a 30% pilot discount and an SLA for production readiness support.
- Monitoring: CloudNova will be placed on watchlist CN-985-W for 90 days. Any attempts to create new accounts tied to the same billing info or repeated trial requests will trigger auto-suspension pending manual review.

Rationale: multiple account identifiers and repeated small top-ups create a pattern consistent with trial gaming. We want to help but need to protect our program and customers. If you can send a PO by EOD Friday, Finance will get the pilot invoice out the same day. Alternatively, if you need an internal approval template for Finance I can send one.

If you want to appeal or escalate, loop in your legal procurement and we'll have Marissa coordinate.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
